youtube.aciklama: The electrode array enters near the round window and moves from the base of the cochlea toward the apex; insertion depth is often expressed as an angle, and one full turn is 360 degrees. Depending on their length, arrays can reach from about one turn to more than one and a half turns; deep insertion may stimulate closer to the low-frequency region, but advancing toward the apex may increase the risk of trauma.
